answer: The inlet counter is kept in vault and pearl makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 10 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 10 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 72 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
